title: agency-pm (Atlas PM)
purpose: Delegation-only AI project manager for agency delivery: task graphs, tracker sync, specialist hiring.
keep: Mongo canonical board + append-only event journal
why: Best-engineered module in the entire pile: real domain logic, real tests, real persistence. The PM brain of AgencyOS.

title: digital-agency (cloud-first platform)
purpose: Cloud-first AI dev platform: teams, projects, workflows, billing, templates, sandbox coding.

run.cmd: npm install; npm run services:up; npm run db:push; npm run dev (5173)

llm.nim: supported - add NIM as OpenAI-compatible provider

keep: Multi-provider abstraction with fallback + encrypted key storage
why: Most complete product platform, but it is Postgres/Redis/Docker-based - the odd one out vs the Mongo+Mastra direction. Not started here because Docker is unavailable on this machine.

title: ai-agency-mastra (workflows + RAG)
purpose: Multi-agent agency platform: Mastra workflows, Mongo persistence, RAG, workspaces, React dashboard.
keep: 5 real workflows: delivery, brand identity, social campaign, landing page, market research
why: Deepest workflow library with live model + persistence wiring. /health confirmed it reports the NIM model.

title: AgencyOS v1 (8 agents)
purpose: AI-native agency OS: lead intake to strategy brief to proposal to project plan, with 8 specialist agents.

llm.nim: patched: added createOpenAI provider shim pointing at NIM

keep: 8 specialist agents: strategist, sales, QA, PM, ops, engineer, designer, content
why: Strongest agent roster plus a real execution worker. Cleanest base for the agent workforce layer.

title: PaulWeezy MVP (client-facing)
purpose: Agency AI assistant UI: conversations with specialised agents, file uploads, dashboard.
keep: Agent CRUD + seeded specialist roster (seeded and verified)
The most finished client-facing UI of the whole set
why: Only iteration whose end-user product feel is complete. Seeded agents returned live from /api/agents.

title: fabel
purpose: V1 agent-powered agency platform with typed workflows and pluggable persistence/AI providers.

llm.nim: native - already NIM-first, only model id changed

keep: First-class NVIDIA NIM client with retries
Provider factory (nim | openai | stub) - the cleanest provider seam in the pile
why: Already built for NIM. Its ai-client-factory should become the shared provider layer for the merged AgencyOS.

title: codex-agency-2 (monorepo)
purpose: Greenfield AgencyOS monorepo: cockpit + client portal, Hono/Mastra runtime, Better Auth, MCP adapters.
keep: Clean monorepo boundaries (web / runtime / agents / db packages)
Better Auth + organization plugin + workspace access control
5 workflows: lead, proposal, onboarding, delivery, QA
Public site + agency dashboard + client portal split
why: Best architecture/skeleton. If you want a long-term structure to merge everything into, this is the shape.

title: agency-os-newerest
purpose: Hybrid agency CRM/PM with an internal AI agent workforce (Mastra-in-Next + MongoDB).
keep: Widest business domain model: lead/client/project lifecycle, change requests, deposits, UAT sign-off, budget alerts, policy gates
why: Richest agency business logic (SOW, deposits, UAT, change requests) - the commercial layer the others lack. Integrations are still mocked.

title: mastra-design-agent
purpose: Design agent producing deliverables, Google Stitch runbooks and Penpot exports, with Mongo vector memory.

llm.nim: configured: base URL repointed to NIM (no code change needed)

why: The only iteration that produces real design deliverables. Fold it in as the Designer agent's toolset.
warning: Its committed .env.example contains what looks like a live OpenRouter key and Penpot token - rotate them.

title: agency-agent-platform (claude)
purpose: Multi-agent agency ops prototype with approval gates and an artifact-producing workflow runner.

llm.nim: patched: added NimAiClient with mock fallback

keep: Human approval gate state machine (approve/reject per step)
why: No database - state dies with the process. Keep the approval-gate design and the AiClient seam, not the storage.

title: workspace-codex-long-horizon (Telegram PM bot)
purpose: Telegram-driven PM task bot with Mongo persistence and Linear/monday mirroring.

run.cmd: npm start (Telegram polling bot - needs TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN)

llm.nim: n/a - no LLM layer at all

keep: Mongo task repository with in-memory fallback
Linear + monday sync with state mapping
why: No LLM layer and it is a bot, not a platform. Keep the Telegram intake channel and tracker sync as an AgencyOS integration.
warning: Contains a committed .env with a live Telegram bot token, Linear API key and Mongo URI - rotate all three.

title: DevKnowledge Base
purpose: Developer knowledge-management product with realtime collaboration.

run.cmd: npm run dev (5173) - empty pnpm-workspace.yaml breaks pnpm; use npm

why: A different product (knowledge base), not an agency OS. Keep the realtime-collab server if AgencyOS ever needs live multiplayer.

title: new-weezy-trea (agent cockpit)
purpose: Cockpit for AI agents: workspaces, GitHub repos, sandboxes, branches, commits, PRs.

run.cmd: npm run client:dev + npm run server:dev

llm.nim: easy - SDK client accepts a baseURL

why: Lots of mocked behaviour and no durable DB, but the GitHub device-flow and sandbox abstraction are genuinely reusable.

title: digital-agency (devin)
purpose: Mastra agency with project/client/task/conversation models and a RAG knowledge base.
why: Its code-generation tools deliberately emit TODO handlers - the agents do not actually produce working code. Superseded by agency-os-v1.

title: agency-again (Maestro)
purpose: Maestro-style orchestrator that splits a brief into projects/sprints/tasks and escalates blockers to a human PM.

llm.nim: patched: wrote a full NIM adapter (the OpenAI adapter was an unimplemented stub)

why: Shipped with a deliberately unimplemented LLM adapter, so it was a mock-only demo. The escalation/message-bus design is the reusable part.

title: mastra-ai-agency
purpose: Mastra agency with 7 agents and Mongo-backed memory.
keep: Mongo memory adapter with thread titles
why: Thin: agents plus memory and little product around it. Strictly a subset of agency-os-v1 and the devin iteration.

title: agencyos-unified (Spark)
purpose: Visual agency-management dashboard: projects, clients, proposals, team, budgets, calendar, time tracking.

llm.nim: needs a server proxy; Spark LLM calls cannot reach NIM directly

keep: Best information architecture of any iteration: budgets, calendar, timesheets, utilization, proposals
why: Locked to the GitHub Spark runtime with no real backend, so it cannot be the platform. Its screens are the best UI spec you have.

title: agency-platform (sonnet)
purpose: Mastra agent library: design, frontend, backend, sales, outreach, research, QA, PM agents.

llm.nim: needs code edit per agent file

keep: Eight well-written agent prompts / role decompositions
why: Prompts only - no persistence, no API, hard-coded models. Harvest the instructions text and discard the shell.

why: v0-generated front end with no backend. Notable only because it already targeted gpt-oss-120b.

why: No AI layer whatsoever. The RBAC/tenancy model is the one thing every other iteration is missing - port that.
